Welcome to the documentation for the 3D Spatial Scene Understanding and Interactive Audio Guidance project for blind users.

## Project Overview

This project aims to develop a comprehensive application for 3D spatial scene understanding and interactive audio guidance tailored for blind users. By leveraging advanced techniques in depth estimation, object detection, and spatial audio rendering, the application seeks to enhance navigation and interaction in various environments.
